contexts.text: The little ones shall be dashed in pieces () = that they will utterly extinguish innocence.
To be dashed in pieces, etc. = the extinction of faith and charity.
To be dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets () = to be dispersed and to perish.

Their bows shall dash the young men in pieces, and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the belly () = that falsities of doctrine will destroy all the understanding of truth and all the good of love.
